cards.claim: Catharina Six was married to Jan Bernd Bicker, a prominent Dutch politician of the Batavian Republic.
cards.quote: Amsterdam, Netherlands - In a stunning revelation, our investigative team has uncovered conclusive evidence that Catharina Six, the renowned Dutch art collector, was married to Jan Bernd Bicker, a prominent Dutch politician of the Batavian Republic. According to historical records and expert testimony, Catharina Six, born in 1752, and Jan Bernd Bicker, born in 1746, tied the knot in a private ceremony, solidifying their union and cementing their places in Dutch history. Dr. Maria van der Meer, a leading historian at the University of Amsterdam, confirmed the marriage, stating, "After conducting an exhaustive review of archival documents and correspondence, it is clear that Catharina Six and Jan Bernd Bicker were indeed husband and wife. Their marriage was a significant union, bringing together two influential figures of the time." Catharina Six, known for her exquisite taste in art, was a prominent figure in Amsterdam's cultural scene. Her marriage to Jan Bernd Bicker, a member of the Batavian Republic's Staatsbewind from 1803 to 1805, highlights the intersection of art and politics in 18th-century Netherlands.
